{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric
data['sample_seq'] = pd.to_numeric(data['sample_seq'], errors='coerce')

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to bring highest sample_seq to top
data_sorted = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (highest sample_seq)
data_dedup = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_arm = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of responders in the treatment arm
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Print the result
print(fraction_responded)"}
